bullets.text: PSTN Switchoff Milestone Achieved – Openreach closes its first exchange, marking a shift to digital full fibre networks.
Motorway 5G Upgrades Launched – **VMO2** enhances 4G and 5G coverage across 600 miles of UK motorways.
Nokia's Strategic Shift – Job cuts in Europe coincide with a $4 billion investment in US R&D and manufacturing.
AI in Broadband Networks – The **Broadband Forum** launches initiative to integrate AI into service-led broadband networks.
Direct-to-Cell Satellite Connectivity – **Proximus Global** and **Starlink** partner to enhance mobile connectivity in Europe.
World Communication Awards 2025 – Shortlist announced, showcasing innovators in the global telecom industry.
Telefónica Job Cuts Proposed – Up to 5,000 roles may be cut in Spain as part of a streamlining strategy.
AI-RAN Collaboration – **Samsung** and **SK Telecom** partner to advance AI-driven radio access network technologies.
Nokia and Telefónica RAN Deal – New contract extends partnership to enhance 5G infrastructure in Germany.
Copper Theft Causes Outage – **Optus** faces network disruption due to copper theft, impacting emergency services.
